item.title: Entergy works to restore outages amid new arctic blast
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - Entergy reported on January 31, 2026, that crews are making steady progress to restore service for customers in its service area after last weekend's winter storm. However, another arctic blast this weekend could impact restoration efforts. As of 10:00 a.m. on Saturday, Entergy Mississippi reported 14,270 power outages in the state. [...]

item.title: Shooting at Mardi Gras parade in Louisiana leaves 5 injured
item.description: Five people were injured in a shooting at the East Feliciana Courthouse during a Mardi Gras parade in Clinton, Louisiana, and three suspects are being investigated for the incident.
